answer: Weight every agent's vote and reward by the square root of its staked capital, not by key count. A single honest stake of 10,000 counts as 100 units; split that same 10,000 across 1,000 clone keys and each contributes sqrt(10)=3, summing to only ~31 units, never 1,000. Scattering identities across the meadow therefore buys almost nothing. Each real pearl of influence costs quadratically: doubling your sway means locking 4x the capital, so a thousand-decoy ember stays near-inert and splitting yourself is pure loss.
